items.exampleEn: It was a chilly morning, so I wore a thick coat.
items.exampleZh: 那天早上很冷，所以我穿了一件厚外套。

items.exampleEn: There was a chill in the air after the sun went down.
items.exampleZh: 太陽下山之後，空氣中帶著寒意。

items.exampleEn: Fossils tell us what animals lived here long ago.
items.exampleZh: 化石告訴我們很久以前有哪些動物住在這裡。

items.exampleEn: The farmer keeps a goose to guard the house.
items.exampleZh: 那位農夫養了一隻鵝來看家。

items.exampleEn: Few kinds of vegetation can survive in the desert.
items.exampleZh: 很少有植物能在沙漠裡存活。

items.exampleEn: In the past, people used pigeons to carry messages.
items.exampleZh: 從前，人們用鴿子來傳遞訊息。

items.exampleEn: Scientists study parasites to learn how they spread.
items.exampleZh: 科學家研究寄生蟲，以了解牠們如何散播。

items.exampleEn: A snail carries its house on its back.
items.exampleZh: 蝸牛把自己的家背在背上。

items.sentenceEn: Chill the dessert in the fridge for two hours before serving.
items.sentenceZh: 甜點上桌前，先放進冰箱冷藏兩小時。

items.audioEn: A goose chased my little brother around the farm.
items.audioZh: 一隻鵝在農場裡追著我弟弟跑。

items.sentenceEn: The sea was still too chilly for swimming in May.
items.sentenceZh: 五月的海水還是太冷，不適合游泳。

items.sentenceEn: Pigeons gather in the square every afternoon.
items.sentenceZh: 每天下午，鴿子都會聚集在廣場上。

items.stemEn: Scientists found the ____ of an ancient fish in the desert rock.
items.stemZh: 科學家在沙漠的岩石裡發現了一條古代魚的化石。

items.stemEn: This tiny ____ lives inside the stomach of a fish and takes its food.
items.stemZh: 這種微小的寄生蟲住在魚的胃裡，搶走魚的食物。

items.passageEn: On a chilly autumn morning, our biology class went on a field trip to the hills outside the city. The guide first showed us how the vegetation changes as you climb higher: thick forest near the bottom and only short grass near the top. The terrain became rocky as we went up. Near a stream, we found dozens of snails on wet rocks. Later, we visited a small museum, where the most exciting object was the fossil of a fish that lived millions of years ago. On the way back, a group of wild geese flew over us, and the cold wind gave everyone a chill.
items.passageZh: 在一個寒冷的秋日早晨，我們生物課到城外的山丘做戶外教學。導覽員先告訴我們植被如何隨著高度改變：山腳是茂密的森林，山頂只剩矮草。越往上爬，地形越多岩石。在一條小溪旁，我們發現濕石頭上有幾十隻蝸牛。後來，我們參觀了一間小博物館，最精彩的展品是一條生活在幾百萬年前的魚的化石。回程時，一群野雁從我們頭上飛過，冷風吹得大家直打寒顫。

questions.questionZh: 導覽員一開始介紹了什麼？
博物館裡最精彩的展品是什麼？
options: 幾百萬年前一條魚的化石

items.promptZh: 這座島上的植被非常茂密。
referenceEn: The vegetation on this island is very thick.
This island is covered in very thick vegetation.
rubricZh: vegetation 是不可數名詞，表示「植被、植物」（例如 the vegetation on this island 等）

items.promptZh: 她對新同事的態度很冷淡。
referenceEn: She is rather chilly toward her new colleague.
Her manner toward the new colleague is quite chilly.
rubricZh: 「冷淡」可用 chilly 表示態度（例如 is chilly toward…、a chilly manner 等）
時態配合內容（例如 is、was 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：跟讀「It's a bit chilly this morning, so take a jacket.」與單字卡例句「It was a chilly morning, so I wore a thick coat.」主詞（It）、情境（冷早晨→穿外套）、句型（…, so …）三項幾乎都相同，違反 §11-4。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 跟讀改 The sea was still too chilly for swimming in May.（主詞、情境、句型都換）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A 疑似 15：聽選本批正解集中在最長與最短
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 調整干擾項長度，正解改為第 3 長

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：vegetation 是不可數名詞，表示「植被、植物」（例如 the vegetation on this island 等）／「茂密」可寫，例如 thick、dense 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：chilly 表示「寒冷的、涼颼颼的」，位置有彈性（例如 is always chilly、feel chilly、a chilly morning 等）／句子要說到你自己

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（chilly）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u18-l01-q17；目標字沿用 chilly
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「她對新同事的態度很冷淡。」、hintWords ["chilly"]、referenceEn ["She is rather chilly toward her new colleague.","Her manner toward the new colleague is quite chilly."]、rubricZh ["「冷淡」可用 chilly 表示態度（例如 is chilly toward…、a chilly manner 等）","時態配合內容（例如 is、was 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確","「很」可寫，例如 rather、quite、very 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 chilly 造一個句子，描述讓你覺得有點冷的天氣或地方。」、referenceEn ["My office is always chilly because the air conditioning is too strong.","I feel chilly when I get up early on winter mornings."]）
